# Etieno Douglas: full details

> Marketing and creative leader based in Nigeria, working remotely worldwide. Runs Aphinity Digital, Creative Lead at Chloe Consulting, founder of The Crucible.

Website: https://etienodouglas.online/

## About

Etieno Douglas works where marketing meets craft: setting strategy, building brands and shipping the websites and products that carry them. He runs Aphinity Digital, an AI-centric digital marketing agency, and is Creative Lead at Chloe Consulting, a HubSpot partner agency. He has led product and brand design for teams in Dubai and beyond. His motto: your dream, my goal.

## Career

- Present: Aphinity Digital. Runs a full-service, AI-centric agency covering branding, SEO, GEO, web, social and out-of-home.
- Jun 2026 to present: Creative Lead, Chloe Consulting (remote). Leads creative direction across B2B client marketing on HubSpot and coaches client teams to run their own marketing pages.
- Apr to Nov 2025: Product & Brand Designer, Kiyapz (Dubai, remote). Led product and brand design, including the company's visual identity and logo.
- Jan 2024 to Sep 2026: Co-Founder, AspectDigita. Co-founded and helped lead a full-service agency offering brand strategy, websites and SEO.

## Principles

- Systems outlast talent: a design system keeps a brand consistent long after the first win.
- A brand is a feeling: your brand is what people say about you when you're not in the room.
- Visibility drives growth: being found by people already searching is what converts.

## Projects

### Splari Academy

- Type: Learning platform
- Link: https://splari.com/
- Summary: A course marketplace where you buy a course once and a working practitioner assesses your final project.
- Splari sells courses for a one-off price, from $30, with the assessment of the learner's final project built into that price. The assessment is done by someone who does that work for a living, so a certificate means a practitioner signed off on real work.
- Beyond the public site, the platform includes a learner dashboard for courses, submissions and certificates, a studio where instructors build and price courses, and admin and operations consoles for applications, payouts and verification.
- What Etieno did: Product strategy and pricing model; UX and visual design system; Next.js front end and Supabase back end; Learner, instructor and admin experiences
- Built with: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Supabase, Vercel
- A free template of this project is available to download.

### Ace Trail Express

- Type: Booking & operations platform
- Link: https://acetrail.vercel.app/
- Summary: Seat booking and a full operations system for a Toyota Sequoia shuttle between Uyo, Port Harcourt and Calabar.
- Customers choose a trip and seat, pay by card or bank transfer and get their ticket by email. Behind the public site sits one operations system for bookings, passengers, manifests, check-in, payments, refunds, expenses and loyalty.
- The staff dashboard lets managers, terminal desks and drivers each land where their work is: today's departures, seats sold, money collected and recent activity, with every sale recorded against the person who made it.
- What Etieno did: Brand refresh and booking UX; Customer booking flow and account area; Staff dashboard for sales, check-in and close-out; Payments, ticketing and serverless API
- Built with: HTML/CSS/JS, Vercel Functions, Supabase, Paystack, Leaflet
- A free template of this project is available to download.

### Tell (Selah)

- Type: Mobile & desktop app
- Link: https://etienodouglas.online/#/work/tell
- Summary: Notes that listen. Record a sermon, talk, class or meeting, and get organised notes, summaries and verified scripture.
- Selah turns speech into structured study notes: clear paragraphs, lists, takeaways and action items, with scripture references detected and checked. A content studio then turns one message into blog posts, devotionals, captions, newsletters and video clip ideas.
- The app is designed offline-first for Android, iOS, web and desktop, with meetings, calendar, folders, reminders and a community space. The prototype below is fully clickable.
- What Etieno did: Product concept and UX; Interactive prototype with demo data; Design tokens and responsive layout rules; Offline-first architecture plan
- Built with: Expo / React Native, TypeScript, Supabase, PowerSync, Tauri
- A free template of this project is available to download.

### Aphinity Invoicing

- Type: SaaS tool
- Link: https://aphinity-app.vercel.app/
- Summary: Invoices for freelancers: polished templates recoloured to your brand, sent by email or WhatsApp.
- A free invoicing tool from Aphinity. Freelancers pick a polished template, recolour it to their brand, get paid by bank transfer, and send invoices over email or WhatsApp. Invoices download as PDF or save to the account.
- What Etieno did: Product design; Invoice templates and brand recolouring; Front-end build
- Built with: Web app, PDF export, Vercel

### Quinema

- Type: Streaming app
- Link: https://quinema-app.vercel.app/
- Summary: A streaming app for movies and games: Nollywood, classics, comedy, horror and more, with lists and chat.
- Quinema brings movies and games into one browsing experience, organised into shelves like Tonight, Classics, Nollywood, Comedy, Horror, Romance and Docs, with a personal list and chat.
- What Etieno did: App UX and interface design; Browse and playback flows; Front-end build
- Built with: Web app, Vercel

### Eco Dash

- Type: Mobile game · Android
- Link: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.PelzStudioLabs.EcoDash
- Summary: An endless runner where you dash through polluted streets, collect trash and learn climate facts along the way.
- Eco Dash turns climate action into a fast-paced endless runner. Players swipe to dodge obstacles, collect trash for points, complete missions, unlock eco-friendly power-ups and rare eco-badges, and pick up surprising climate facts as they run.
- Recent updates added more characters, a trash-to-currency system, environment modes like Night Mode, and smoother gameplay. The game is live on Google Play and rated for everyone.
- What Etieno did: Game UI design; Home, boosters and character select screens; In-game HUD and menus
- Built with: Android, Google Play

- What Etieno did: Brand and messaging; Website design and build; Service and pricing structure
- Built with: TypeScript, Vercel

## Leadership & Impact

The Crucible (https://crucible.etienodouglas.online/) is a growth community for young people who want to build themselves and make real impact, founded by Etieno Douglas. Its three focuses are self-building, leadership and impact. He also partners with Love Unites International (https://loveunitesinternational.org/), a humanitarian nonprofit. He offers talks and workshops on leadership, purpose and building in the digital age, youth programme partnerships, and mentorship for young people and emerging leaders.

## Frequently asked questions

### Who is Etieno Douglas?

Etieno Douglas is a marketing and creative leader based in Nigeria, working remotely with clients worldwide. He runs Aphinity Digital, an AI-centric digital marketing agency, is Creative Lead at Chloe Consulting, a HubSpot partner agency, and founded The Crucible, a youth development and leadership community.

### What services does Etieno Douglas offer?

Marketing strategy and growth, including SEO and visibility in AI answer engines; brand and identity; web design and development on HubSpot CMS, Webflow, WordPress or custom code; and products and platforms such as booking systems, learning platforms and apps.

### What is Aphinity Digital?

Aphinity Digital is an AI-centric, full-service digital marketing agency run by Etieno Douglas. It covers branding, SEO, GEO, web design, social media, billboards and events. Its website is aphinity.digital.

### What is The Crucible?

The Crucible is a growth community for young people who want to build themselves and make real impact, founded by Etieno Douglas. It focuses on self-building, leadership and impact. Its website is crucible.etienodouglas.online.

### What projects has Etieno Douglas built?

His 14 portfolio projects include Splari Academy, a course marketplace; Ace Trail Express, a seat-booking site with a staff operations dashboard; Tell, a notes app prototype; Eco Dash, an Android game; and websites for Love Unites International, Almanac, D-Vine Consults and others.

### Are Etieno Douglas's website templates free?

Yes. Three templates are free to download from the portfolio: a booking platform, a learning platform built with Next.js and a notes app prototype. Each comes with placeholder copy and the original images.

### How can I work with Etieno Douglas?

Message him on LinkedIn at linkedin.com/in/etienookondouglas, or start a project through Aphinity Digital at aphinity.digital. For leadership work, he is available for speaking, youth programme partnerships and mentorship.
